# strpip: Data Structure Pipelines for Genomic Analysis

[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/hungms/strpip/workflows/R-CMD-check/badge.svg)](https://github.com/hungms/strpip/actions)
[![pkgdown](https://github.com/hungms/strpip/workflows/pkgdown/badge.svg)](https://github.com/hungms/strpip/actions)

A comprehensive R package for genomic data structure pipelines,
providing tools for data format conversions, gene symbol mapping, gene
set operations, expression data processing, and functional annotation
integration.

## Documentation

For detailed documentation and examples, please visit our latest
[documentation](https://hungms.github.io/strpip/).

## Features

### Gene Symbol Mapping

- Convert between human and mouse gene symbols
- Map between different gene ID types

### Specialized Gene Set Operations

- Identify X/Y chromosome genes
- Find mitochondrial genes
- Filter structural genes
- Perform set operations on gene lists

### Expression Processing

- Summarize gene expression data
- Filter and normalize expression matrices
- Handle duplicate gene entries

### Functional Annotation

- Integrate pathway annotations
- Access OmniPath resources
- Perform enrichment analyses

### Data Format Operations

- Read and write GCT (Gene Cluster Text) files
- Read and write GMT (Gene Matrix Transposed) files
- Convert between different genomic data formats

## Installation

You can install the development version of strpip from GitHub:

``` r
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("hungms/strpip")
```

## Dependencies

The package requires the following dependencies, which can be installed
with:

``` r
# Install CRAN packages
install.packages(c("dplyr", "tidyr", "tibble", "stringr", "magrittr"))

# Install Bioconductor packages
if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install(c("biomaRt"))
```

These packages provide: - biomaRt: Access to Ensembl BioMart databases -
dplyr, tidyr, tibble, stringr: Data manipulation tools - magrittr: For
pipe operations - OmnipathR: Access to protein interaction networks and
pathway data

# Package index

## Annotate Functions

- [`run_annotation()`](https://hungms.github.io/strpip/reference/run_annotation.md)
  : Add Gene Annotations

## Gene Conversion

- [`get_conversion_dict()`](https://hungms.github.io/strpip/reference/get_conversion_dict.md)
  : Convert mouse gene symbols
- [`convert_df()`](https://hungms.github.io/strpip/reference/convert_df.md)
  : Convert data frame between species efficiently
- [`convert_exprs()`](https://hungms.github.io/strpip/reference/convert_exprs.md)
  : Convert expression matrix or data frame between species efficiently
- [`convert_genes()`](https://hungms.github.io/strpip/reference/convert_genes.md)
  : Convert genes between species efficiently

## BiomaRt Functions

- [`import_biomart()`](https://hungms.github.io/strpip/reference/import_biomart.md)
  : Import BioMart data from Ensembl archive
- [`import_biomart_human()`](https://hungms.github.io/strpip/reference/import_biomart_human.md)
  : Import BioMart data from Ensembl archive
- [`import_biomart_mouse()`](https://hungms.github.io/strpip/reference/import_biomart_mouse.md)
  : Import BioMart data from Ensembl archive

## Find Genes

- [`get_cc_genes()`](https://hungms.github.io/strpip/reference/get_cc_genes.md)
  : Get cell cycle genes
- [`get_conversion_dict()`](https://hungms.github.io/strpip/reference/get_conversion_dict.md)
  : Convert mouse gene symbols
- [`get_mt_genes()`](https://hungms.github.io/strpip/reference/get_mt_genes.md)
  : Get genes from mitochondrial chromosome
- [`get_str_genes()`](https://hungms.github.io/strpip/reference/get_str_genes.md)
  : Get genes matching specific patterns
- [`get_xy_genes()`](https://hungms.github.io/strpip/reference/get_xy_genes.md)
  : Get genes from X and Y chromosomes
- [`bcr.string`](https://hungms.github.io/strpip/reference/bcr.string.md)
  : Regular expression pattern for BCR genes
- [`hb.string`](https://hungms.github.io/strpip/reference/hb.string.md)
  : Regular expression pattern for hemoglobin genes
- [`mhc.string`](https://hungms.github.io/strpip/reference/mhc.string.md)
  : Regular expression pattern for MHC genes
- [`mt.string`](https://hungms.github.io/strpip/reference/mt.string.md)
  : Regular expression pattern for mitochondrial genes
- [`rb.string`](https://hungms.github.io/strpip/reference/rb.string.md)
  : Regular expression pattern for ribosomal genes
- [`tcr.string`](https://hungms.github.io/strpip/reference/tcr.string.md)
  : Regular expression pattern for TCR genes

## Summarize Genes

- [`summarize_genes()`](https://hungms.github.io/strpip/reference/summarize_genes.md)
  : Summarize Gene Expression

## Format Functions

- [`list_to_df()`](https://hungms.github.io/strpip/reference/list_to_df.md)
  : Convert List to Data Frame
- [`df_to_list()`](https://hungms.github.io/strpip/reference/df_to_list.md)
  : Convert Data Frame to List
- [`read_gct()`](https://hungms.github.io/strpip/reference/read_gct.md)
  : Read GCT File
- [`read_gmt()`](https://hungms.github.io/strpip/reference/read_gmt.md)
  : Read GMT File
- [`write_gct()`](https://hungms.github.io/strpip/reference/write_gct.md)
  : Write GCT File
- [`write_gmt()`](https://hungms.github.io/strpip/reference/write_gmt.md)
  : Write GMT File
